criteria.requirement: Validate real IceCreamDebugger constructor/configureOutput declarations before mutating any field or auto-swapping builtin color output. Prefix must be text/callable, formatting/output callbacks callable, flags actual bool and lineWrapWidth positive non-bool int. Preserve Sentinel.absent, empty prefixes, valid callbacks and existing builtin noColor output swap rules. Never execute a prefix/formatter during validation or pretend to know its eventual return type; callback execution failures remain runtime failures. Invalid combinations, unknown kwargs or no-arg configure must leave all previous fields identical, including prefix and outputFunction.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
